recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the remaining visible-text part of FHIR-12632 without broadening the issue into unrelated profile or extension example changes.
issue_request: FHIR-12632 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request to replace DSTU2 DAF profile examples in the StructureDefinition and ElementDefinition notes with STU3/core profile examples. The Jira description named Vital Signs and ClinicalDocument; the resolution named Data Absent Reason and ClinicalDocument.
initial_application: The historical application commit 77cd78889cce26f63b32f940eb5ad1d3a5eeed7f changed StructureDefinition examples to ClinicalDocument and Data Absent Reason and changed the ElementDefinition resource-constraint example links from DAF Patient URLs to local vitalsigns profile URLs. That ElementDefinition hunk left the visible text as DAF Patient.
additional_context: The current StructureDefinition notes have since been refactored and no longer carry the old ClinicalDocument resource-constraint example, while they do retain a current Data Absent Reason extension example through the extensions-location macro. ElementDefinition remains an active type page, and the current vitalsigns profile source title is Vital Signs Base Profile.
reconciliation: Changed source/elementdefinition.html so the resource-constraint example link to vitalsigns.html displays Vital Signs Base Profile instead of DAF Patient. No StructureDefinition edit was needed.
source_changes: source/elementdefinition.html: changed the resource-constraint example label from DAF Patient to Vital Signs Base Profile while preserving the existing vitalsigns profile links.
